technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with price at new highs and bullish technicals, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and weak volume ratio create elevated pullback risk; suitable for scaled entry or confirmation of reversal before committing.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (340.64) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 63 days adds event risk to already hostile environment.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI(9/14), Stochastic, and Williams %R combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve recession signal, zero fundamental support, and weak volume ratio (0.77) create unacceptable risk/reward for entry.
